Messages.Author: pgh...@city-net.com
Messages.Body:
In article <4tlhm1$1...@newsbf02.news.aol.com>, red...@aol.com (Red Ned) wrote:

> Do Blood agony cards exist.. where are they?

I bought four boxes of AH and won another 14 packs and I got about 5 blood
agony cards. The hardest card for me to get was Beyond Reproach. It also
seems that many store in my area are out of the cards completely.

Doesn't the Sabbat, by definition, have very little to do with the Jyhad?

No, It has quite a great deal to do with the Jyhad. It has only distanced
itself from Camarilla politics and started their own political
aspirations. And the Sabbat is quite visable in undermining the Camarilla
politics, trying to take over their cities, and recruit from the Camarilla
ranks. Many Sabbat act as undercover spies infiltrating the Camarilla
ranks trying to overturn Camarilla order. So in actuality the Sabbat fit
right in especially if you are a Methesulah who is interested in causing
havoc.

randy.

Messages.Author: Shawn F. Carnes
Messages.Body:
Red Ned wrote:
>
> Do Blood agony cards exist.. where are they? I just don't see the point
> of the upcoming set of cards. Doesn't the Sabbat, by definition, have
> very little to do with the Jyhad? It would be similar to making "Rage"
> compatible with Jyhad. Or, plaagh, the new changeling game.

Blood Agony--check out the Ancient Hearts expansion, I believe, and there you will find
what you seek.

Sabbat & the Jyhad--okay... I will be admitting that I'm a White Wolf goob in this
response. ;) The Sabbat, per se, are just as prone to manipulations by the
Methuselahs who wage the Jyhad as are the Camarilla. Why would a Methuselah care about
whether his minions were Sabbat or Camarilla? So long as they served her needs, she
would not care. Some Methuselahs, however, may have a preference. I know if I were a
Methuselah and I wanted some serious heavy-hitting vamps to do a job, I'd look into
recruiting and dominating some Sabbat vampires.
